create_imagic_pipeline: create an ImagicStableDiffusionPipeline instance with vae, text_encoder, tokenizer, unet, scheduler, safety_checker, and feature_extractor
train_text_embedding: train the pipeline to optimize text embeddings for a given prompt and input image
fine_tune_unet_model: fine-tune the UNet model to better reconstruct the input image after text embedding optimization
generate_edited_image: generate an edited image by interpolating between original and optimized text embeddings with alpha
preprocess_input_image: preprocess a PIL image by resizing to multiple of 32, normalizing, and converting to a torch tensor
